correctness.rationale: The disk area measure is 2 mu dmu. Independent exact elimination of the weighted three-by-three normal equations gives the fitted fractional term -8/231+(40/77)(mu+mu^2); positive definiteness of the Gram matrix follows from the positive integral of the square of each nonzero polynomial. Fitting the free constant makes the mean residual exactly zero, and the true mean is positive. At fixed b<1 the planet is wholly inside the disk for sufficiently small radius, and continuity gives the leading occulted-area factor times the local intensity; the common mean therefore reduces the normalized difference to a nonzero multiple of the single residual. With t=sqrt(mu) this residual is -1/231 times the quoted quartic. Its three disjoint rational sign brackets and the three Descartes sign variations give exactly three positive roots, simple and in (0,1). The endpoint at b=0 is not a zero and b=1 is excluded. The quartic is positive at t=1; since t decreases as b grows, the model-minus-true sign sequence for c>0 is +,-,+,-. Positivity of the fitted law is needed only for its physical interpretation, not the root calculation.
